1. Algorithmic complexity (flag O(n²)+ on unbounded inputs)
2. Memory allocation hotspots (object creation in loops, unbounded caches)
3. Async performance (sequential awaits → Promise.all, missing timeouts, stream backpressure)

Pay particular attention to whether the case-insensitivity fix for email/confirmEmail comparison introduces unnecessary string transformations (e.g. repeated .toLowerCase() calls) inside render paths, validation loops, or form re-validation triggers, since React form libraries can re-invoke validators on every keystroke.
